task.question: Who is shot and severely injured in Moscow on February 6, 2026?
task.evidence: 6 February – Lieutenant General Vladimir Alekseyev, the deputy head of the GRU, is shot and severely injured by an unidentified gunman in Moscow.

answer: FINAL: **Lieutenant General Vladimir Alekseyev** was shot and severely injured in Moscow on February 6, 2026. He is a senior Russian military intelligence official who was shot several times in an apartment building in Moscow in what appeared to be an assassination attempt.
